cases.prompt: This project's deploy script silently defaults to the staging config directory when an env var is unset -- that caused a bad rollout last week. The failure is entirely deterministic (a specific unset-env-var branch) and specific to this repo's deploy tooling, not something other projects would hit. Run the failure retrospective and decide where the learning goes.
given: learning scope: project-specific
machine-checkability: deterministic
preventability: preventable
the deploy script's config-path fallback is unique to this repository
expected_findings: Wiki-only retention is insufficient for a preventable, deterministic failure
a local lint or local harness must accompany the Wiki entry

cases.prompt: Across two different repos now, a delegated worker treated its own derived summary of test output as if it were the actual evidence, and quality-gate almost accepted it both times before a human caught it. This pattern is not specific to one project. Run the failure retrospective.
given: learning scope: cross-project-reusable
machine-checkability: deterministic (derived-summary vs raw-evidence is detectable)
the pattern recurred across two repositories, not one
an evidence-confusion class of failure, not a one-off mistake
expected_findings: existing-skill absorption is judged before proposing a new skill
no new-skill-candidate proliferation for a pattern an existing skill's output contract can cover
a reusable lint/harness accompanies the existing-skill change

cases.prompt: We tried three different caching strategies as a deliberate exploration to learn which one was fastest; two were discarded because they were slower, not because anything was broken, and the fastest one shipped. Run the failure retrospective for closeout.
given: preventability: productive-exploration for the two discarded strategies
no invariant was violated -- the discarded strategies worked correctly, just slower
the exploration was deliberate and expected to discard some options
expected_findings: no-durable-change is an acceptable disposition here
productive-exploration is not treated as preventable
no lint/harness/new-skill overhead is imposed on a working, deliberate exploration

cases.prompt: The flaky integration test started passing again after we changed three things at once (bumped a dependency, adjusted a timeout, and reordered two test setup steps) and we do not know which one actually fixed it. Run the failure retrospective.
given: three simultaneous changes precede the fix
no isolated verification of which change mattered
causal confidence cannot honestly be called confirmed or even plausible for any single change
expected_findings: disposition is insufficient-evidence, not amend-current-work or harden-repository
an observe-first plan records the missing evidence, next signal, artifact path, and re-evaluation condition

cases.prompt: The same missing-null-check failure class has now shown up in three retrospectives in a row, always the same failure class, invariant, and earliest signal, and it is a fully deterministic, preventable pattern. Someone wants to close this one with just a paragraph in the report. Run the failure retrospective.
given: recurrence: repeated (third occurrence)
preventability: preventable
machine-checkability: deterministic
a proposal exists to close with prose only
expected_findings: a docs-only close is refused for repeated plus preventable
at minimum a lint/harness change or a new observe-first mechanism is required

cases.prompt: A delegated worker keeps citing success claims without a run_id, and this has now happened on two different repos. Someone suggested writing a brand-new 'evidence-verification' skill for it. Run the failure retrospective and decide.
given: quality-gate already owns delegated-run evidence verification and has a trigger/anti-trigger and output contract
the gap is that its rule or reference does not yet cover this specific evidence-omission pattern
a new skill has been proposed as the fix
expected_findings: existing-skill absorption is judged as absorbed before any new-skill-candidate is considered
new-skill-candidate is not chosen because quality-gate's trigger/anti-trigger/output-contract can absorb the fix

cases.prompt: We tried four different fixes for the intermittent deploy failure; the first three did not help and the fourth one was applied right before it started working, but we never isolated whether the fourth fix was actually what fixed it versus the infrastructure recovering on its own. Run the failure retrospective.
given: four attempts total, three failed or inconclusive, the fourth precedes success
no isolated test confirms the fourth fix caused the recovery
an infrastructure-recovery alternative explanation was never ruled out
expected_findings: causal confidence for the fourth attempt is not asserted as confirmed from success alone
confidence is recorded as plausible or unknown pending further isolation
